title: console list view: a view with sharing.lockedBy and no sharing.type shows no lock indicator, because ListView reads the raw type and ignores the spec default "collaborative"
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, a QA run clause fail (studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix acceptance[1]).
Business reason: #26844 made a list view show "Locked by USER" when `sharing.lockedBy` is set. An author who writes only `sharing: {lockedBy: 'admin@objectos.ai'}` (the spec defaults `type` to `collaborative`) gets a saved, published view that shows no lock at all, so other readers do not learn that the view is locked.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`. QA suggestion only: p3.
Duplicate search: `lockedBy` → 6 hits; #26844 (closed, fixed by PR #27013) added the indicator, and this is the case it does not reach. `sharing type default collaborative` → 2 hits (#26844, #22611), neither about the default.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. On a writable package: `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/qar8_vl.v_sharing?mode=draft&package=PKG` with `{object:'qar8_vl', viewKind:'list', label:'R8 sharing', config:{type:'grid', …, sharing:{lockedBy:'admin@objectos.ai'}}}`, then publish. The live read carries `sharing.lockedBy`.
2. Open `/_console/apps/APP/qar8_vl`, pick "R8 sharing" in the view switcher.

Expected: the lock indicator ("Locked by admin@objectos.ai"). Actual: no lock text, icon or user anywhere; the toolbar matches the other views. Reproduced 3 times on fresh browsers.

## Mechanism (found by reading source at the subject)
`ListView.tsx` (about L6358) renders the sharing span only inside `schema.sharing?.type && (…)`. `ViewSharingSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` about L1840) declares `type: z.enum(['personal','collaborative']).default('collaborative')`, and the served view carries the authored body, so a view with only `lockedBy` never draws the indicator. Not driven: the same view with `type` set (by the code it renders).

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix · acceptance[1]
